title: PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to initiating street vacation proceedings to vacate four alleys along Gramercy Place.
text:
[Council File 25-1355; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to initiating street vacation proceedings to vacate four alleys along Gramercy Place.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Harris-Dawson - Hutt):
1. INITIATE the street vacation proceedings to vacate the following four alleys along Gramercy Place, pursuant to California Streets and Highways Code, Division 9, Part 3, Public Streets, Highways, and Service Easements Vacation Law:
a. The alley south of 41st Place and north of 42nd Street between Gramercy Place and Van Ness Avenue.
b. The alley south of 43rd Street and north of 43rd Place between Gramercy Place and Van Ness Avenue.
c. The alley south of 43rd Place and north of Vernon Avenue between Gramercy Place and Van Ness Avenue.
d. The alley south of 43rd Place and north of Vernon Avenue between Gramercy Place and St. Andrews Place.
2. DIRECT the Bureau of Engineering (BOE) to investigate the feasibility of these vacation requests.
3. DIRECT the BOE to present its report(s) regarding the feasibility of vacating the requested areas to the Public Works Committee.
4. DIRECT the City Clerk, upon review of the Public Works Committee, to schedule these requests for Council consideration at the appropriate time(s) under the City Street Vacation procedures.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes For: Empowerment Congress Central Neighborhood Council
summary: Council would start street vacation proceedings to close four alleys along Gramercy Place.
